rival_pallet_1.name: Rival
rival_pallet_1.title: Pokémon Trainer
rival_pallet_1.dialogueBefore: Wait! Let's check out our Pokémon! I'll take you on!
rival_pallet_1.dialogueAfter: WHAT? Unbelievable! I picked the wrong Pokémon!

bug_catcher_rick.name: Rick
bug_catcher_rick.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_rick.dialogueBefore: Hey! My bug Pokémon are tough. Care to see?
bug_catcher_rick.dialogueAfter: Aww, they just weren't strong enough!

bug_catcher_doug.name: Doug
bug_catcher_doug.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_doug.dialogueBefore: You can't escape if you come into the forest!

lass_janice.name: Janice
lass_janice.title: Lass
lass_janice.dialogueBefore: Excuse me! Don't be so impatient, let's battle!
lass_janice.dialogueAfter: Oh well! I'll just have to train harder.

pewter_gym_camper_liam.name: Camper Liam
pewter_gym_camper_liam.title: Camper
pewter_gym_camper_liam.dialogueBefore: Stop right there! You're gonna have to get past me to challenge Brock!
pewter_gym_camper_liam.dialogueAfter: Darn! You're tougher than you look.

leader_brock.name: Brock
leader_brock.title: Gym Leader
leader_brock.dialogueBefore: I'm Brock! Pewter's Gym Leader! My rock-hard willpower is absolute!
leader_brock.dialogueAfter: It's an amazing feeling... You're stronger than I expected.

camper_liam.name: Liam
camper_liam.title: Camper
camper_liam.dialogueBefore: You'd better have a plan for Brock's rock-hard Pokémon!
camper_liam.dialogueAfter: Whoa! You might actually stand a chance against Brock!

brock_gym.name: Brock
brock_gym.title: Gym Leader
brock_gym.dialogueBefore: I'm Brock! Pewter's Gym Leader! My rock-hard willpower is absolute!
brock_gym.dialogueAfter: It's an amazing feeling... You're stronger than I expected. Take this Boulder Badge!

swimmer_mira.name: Mira
swimmer_mira.title: Swimmer
swimmer_mira.dialogueBefore: The water's fine... for my Pokémon, anyway!
swimmer_mira.dialogueAfter: Blub... blub... You swim better than I thought.

picnicker_diana.name: Diana
picnicker_diana.title: Picnicker
picnicker_diana.dialogueBefore: Misty taught me everything I know about water Pokémon!
picnicker_diana.dialogueAfter: You're as graceful as a Starmie in battle!

misty_gym.name: Misty
misty_gym.title: Gym Leader
misty_gym.dialogueBefore: Hi, you're a new face! Trainers who want to turn me down have to show me in a battle!
misty_gym.dialogueAfter: Wow! You're too much! All right! Take the Cascade Badge!

gentleman_tucker.name: Tucker
gentleman_tucker.title: Gentleman
gentleman_tucker.dialogueBefore: A gentleman never backs down from an electrifying battle!
gentleman_tucker.dialogueAfter: Quite shocking! Most stimulating, old chap!

rocker_biff.name: Biff
rocker_biff.title: Rocker
rocker_biff.dialogueBefore: Time to turn the voltage up to eleven!
rocker_biff.dialogueAfter: You blew my amp! ...I mean, my team!

sailor_dwayne.name: Dwayne
sailor_dwayne.title: Sailor
sailor_dwayne.dialogueBefore: These electric-types have weathered every storm at sea!
sailor_dwayne.dialogueAfter: Blown off course! You're a strong trainer!

surge_gym.name: Lt. Surge
surge_gym.title: Gym Leader
surge_gym.dialogueBefore: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here? You won't live long in combat! That's for sure!
surge_gym.dialogueAfter: Whoa! You're the real deal, kid! Take the Thunder Badge!

cooltrainer_samuel.name: Samuel
cooltrainer_samuel.title: Cooltrainer
cooltrainer_samuel.dialogueBefore: Giovanni's training regime is no joke. Neither am I.
cooltrainer_samuel.dialogueAfter: Hmm. Giovanni will want to hear about you.

blackbelt_atsushi.name: Atsushi
blackbelt_atsushi.title: Blackbelt
blackbelt_atsushi.dialogueBefore: My fists and my Pokémon strike as one!
blackbelt_atsushi.dialogueAfter: Your spirit burned brighter. I yield!

giovanni_gym.name: Giovanni
giovanni_gym.title: Gym Leader
giovanni_gym.dialogueBefore: I am the leader here. You dare challenge me? You are a fool!
giovanni_gym.dialogueAfter: Ha! That was a truly intense fight. You have won! Take the Earth Badge!

lass_crissy.name: Crissy
lass_crissy.title: Lass
lass_crissy.dialogueBefore: I picked these cuties myself on Route 4!
lass_crissy.dialogueAfter: They're still cute even when they lose!

lass_ali.name: Ali
lass_ali.title: Lass
lass_ali.dialogueBefore: Nugget Bridge is no place for the unprepared!

camper_ricky.name: Ricky
camper_ricky.title: Camper
camper_ricky.dialogueBefore: I'm camping out here and training my Pokémon!

team_rocket_nugget_grunt.name: Grunt
team_rocket_nugget_grunt.title: Team Rocket
team_rocket_nugget_grunt.dialogueBefore: Hey, kid! Want to join Team Rocket? ...No? Then battle me!
team_rocket_nugget_grunt.dialogueAfter: Tch! Fine, take this Nugget and get lost!

hiker_franklin.name: Franklin
hiker_franklin.title: Hiker
hiker_franklin.dialogueBefore: These trails forged my Pokémon into stone!

youngster_dillon.name: Dillon
youngster_dillon.title: Youngster
youngster_dillon.dialogueBefore: Bill's cottage is just ahead, but first... battle!
youngster_dillon.dialogueAfter: Aw, I wanted to show Bill my Pokémon!

lass_haley.name: Haley
lass_haley.title: Lass
lass_haley.dialogueBefore: I came to see Bill, but I'll battle you instead!
lass_haley.dialogueAfter: You're way stronger than the rumors said!

hiker_marcos.name: Marcos
hiker_marcos.title: Hiker
hiker_marcos.dialogueBefore: Careful in these caves, kid. Let me test your footing!

bug_catcher_kent.name: Kent
bug_catcher_kent.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_kent.dialogueBefore: Cave bugs are the toughest bugs!

team_rocket_grunt_1.name: Grunt
team_rocket_grunt_1.title: Team Rocket
team_rocket_grunt_1.dialogueBefore: We're digging for fossils! Beat it, kid!

super_nerd_miguel.name: Miguel
super_nerd_miguel.title: Super Nerd
super_nerd_miguel.dialogueBefore: Halt! These fossils belong to Team Rocket!

rival_cerulean.name: Rival
rival_cerulean.title: Pokémon Trainer
rival_cerulean.dialogueBefore: Hey! You're still struggling? Let me show you how a real trainer battles!
rival_cerulean.dialogueAfter: What?! I had a type advantage! ...This isn't over!

lass_kay.name: Kay
lass_kay.title: Lass
lass_kay.dialogueBefore: Erika's garden is the prettiest battlefield in Kanto!
lass_kay.dialogueAfter: Your battle style is beautiful too!

beauty_bridget.name: Bridget
beauty_bridget.title: Beauty
beauty_bridget.dialogueBefore: A lady never wilts, and neither do my Pokémon!
beauty_bridget.dialogueAfter: Oh, my! You plucked my winning streak!

picnicker_tina.name: Tina
picnicker_tina.title: Picnicker
picnicker_tina.dialogueBefore: I had a picnic in Erika's garden once. Now I battle in it!
picnicker_tina.dialogueAfter: That was more fun than sandwiches!

lass_tamia.name: Tamia
lass_tamia.title: Lass
lass_tamia.dialogueBefore: Grass Pokémon are gentle, but don't mistake gentle for weak!

beauty_lori.name: Lori
beauty_lori.title: Beauty
beauty_lori.dialogueBefore: Erika taught me that beauty blooms brightest in battle!
beauty_lori.dialogueAfter: Wilted... like a flower in winter.

cooltrainer_mary.name: Mary
cooltrainer_mary.title: Cooltrainer
cooltrainer_mary.dialogueBefore: I've trained in every garden in Kanto. This one is the toughest.
cooltrainer_mary.dialogueAfter: Even the toughest garden has weeds. Like me, apparently.

beauty_jessica.name: Jessica
beauty_jessica.title: Beauty
beauty_jessica.dialogueBefore: One last petal stands between you and Erika: me!
beauty_jessica.dialogueAfter: You plucked me too! Erika won't be so easy!

erika_gym.name: Erika
erika_gym.title: Gym Leader
erika_gym.dialogueBefore: Hello. My name is Erika. I am the Leader of the Celadon Gym. I am a student of the art of flower arranging. My Pokémon are all of the grass-type. Oh, I hope you will not be disappointed by my humble skills.
erika_gym.dialogueAfter: Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong. I must confer on you the Rainbow Badge.

tamer_phil.name: Phil
tamer_phil.title: Tamer
tamer_phil.dialogueBefore: Koga's invisible walls hide more than just the Gym!
tamer_phil.dialogueAfter: You saw right through my tricks!

tamer_edgar.name: Edgar
tamer_edgar.title: Tamer
tamer_edgar.dialogueBefore: My poisons are as invisible as these walls!
tamer_edgar.dialogueAfter: Antidote... I need an antidote for this defeat!

juggler_kirk.name: Kirk
juggler_kirk.title: Juggler
juggler_kirk.dialogueBefore: Watch closely! My Pokémon disappear... into battle!
juggler_kirk.dialogueAfter: Now you see them, now you don't... I lost!

juggler_ned.name: Ned
juggler_ned.title: Juggler
juggler_ned.dialogueBefore: A juggler never drops a Pokémon! Or a battle!
juggler_ned.dialogueAfter: Dropped it! I dropped the battle!

juggler_kayden.name: Kayden
juggler_kayden.title: Juggler
juggler_kayden.dialogueBefore: Koga's final test is me! And I'm no joke!

koga_gym.name: Koga
koga_gym.title: Gym Leader
koga_gym.dialogueBefore: Aiiieee! You have come to challenge me? Very well. I shall show you the true power of poison!
koga_gym.dialogueAfter: Ah! You have proven your worth! Take the Soul Badge!

psychic_johan.name: Johan
psychic_johan.title: Psychic
psychic_johan.dialogueBefore: I foresaw your arrival. I also foresaw my victory.

chaneller_amanda.name: Amanda
chaneller_amanda.title: Channeler
chaneller_amanda.dialogueBefore: The spirits whisper that you will lose!

psychic_tyron.name: Tyron
psychic_tyron.title: Psychic
psychic_tyron.dialogueBefore: Sabrina's mind is as sharp as her Pokémon's.

chaneller_stacy.name: Stacy
chaneller_stacy.title: Channeler
chaneller_stacy.dialogueBefore: I channel the power of the unseen world!
chaneller_stacy.dialogueAfter: The unseen world has abandoned me!

psychic_cameron.name: Cameron
psychic_cameron.title: Psychic
psychic_cameron.dialogueBefore: Your thoughts betray you. You fear my power.
psychic_cameron.dialogueAfter: Impossible! You thought of nothing but victory!

chaneller_tasha.name: Tasha
chaneller_tasha.title: Channeler
chaneller_tasha.dialogueBefore: One step closer to Sabrina. One step closer to defeat!

psychic_preston.name: Preston
psychic_preston.title: Psychic
psychic_preston.dialogueBefore: I am Sabrina's final shield. You shall not pass!
psychic_preston.dialogueAfter: My mind... is blank. You win.

sabrina_gym.name: Sabrina
sabrina_gym.title: Gym Leader
sabrina_gym.dialogueBefore: I had a vision of your arrival. I have had psychic powers since I was a child. I dislike battling, but if you wish, I will show you my powers!
sabrina_gym.dialogueAfter: I'm surprised, but a loss is a loss. Take the Marsh Badge.

super_nerd_erik.name: Erik
super_nerd_erik.title: Super Nerd
super_nerd_erik.dialogueBefore: My calculations say fire beats everything! Let me demonstrate!
super_nerd_erik.dialogueAfter: My calculations failed to account for you!

burglar_ramon.name: Ramon
burglar_ramon.title: Burglar
burglar_ramon.dialogueBefore: I'll steal this victory right from under you!
burglar_ramon.dialogueAfter: You've robbed me of my win!

super_nerd_dusty.name: Dusty
super_nerd_dusty.title: Super Nerd
super_nerd_dusty.dialogueBefore: Did you know? Fire Pokémon's body temperature exceeds 900 degrees!

burglar_arnie.name: Arnie
burglar_arnie.title: Burglar
burglar_arnie.dialogueBefore: This gym is a quiz and a battle! Hope you studied!

super_nerd_zack.name: Zack
super_nerd_zack.title: Super Nerd
super_nerd_zack.dialogueBefore: Blaine's riddles are nothing compared to his Pokémon!
super_nerd_zack.dialogueAfter: Riddle me this: how did I lose?!

burglar_dusty.name: Dusty
burglar_dusty.title: Burglar
burglar_dusty.dialogueBefore: No, not that Dusty. I'm the burglar one! Battle me!
burglar_dusty.dialogueAfter: Wrong Dusty to mess with, huh?

super_nerd_bryan.name: Bryan
super_nerd_bryan.title: Super Nerd
super_nerd_bryan.dialogueBefore: I'm Blaine's last line of defense! My data is flawless!

blaine_gym.name: Blaine
blaine_gym.title: Gym Leader
blaine_gym.dialogueBefore: Hah! I am Blaine! I am the Leader of the Cinnabar Gym! My fiery Pokémon will incinerate all challengers!
blaine_gym.dialogueAfter: I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain! You have earned the Volcano Badge!

blackbelt_hitoshi.name: Hitoshi
blackbelt_hitoshi.title: Blackbelt
blackbelt_hitoshi.dialogueBefore: Our karate blows will crush you!
blackbelt_hitoshi.dialogueAfter: Your spirit is stronger than my fists!

blackbelt_aaron.name: Aaron
blackbelt_aaron.title: Blackbelt
blackbelt_aaron.dialogueBefore: The dojo's honor rests on my shoulders!

master_karate.name: Koichi
master_karate.title: Karate Master
master_karate.dialogueBefore: Yo! I am the Karate Master! I am the leader of this dojo! You dare challenge me?
master_karate.dialogueAfter: Wah! You are strong! Choose one of the fighting Pokémon as your prize!

bug_catcher_colton.name: Colton
bug_catcher_colton.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_colton.dialogueBefore: My Bug Pokémon are the best! Let me show you!

youngster_ben.name: Ben
youngster_ben.title: Youngster
youngster_ben.dialogueBefore: I'm going to be the greatest trainer ever!

bug_catcher_greg.name: Greg
bug_catcher_greg.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_greg.dialogueBefore: Bugs are so cool, don't you think?

youngster_calvin.name: Calvin
youngster_calvin.title: Youngster
youngster_calvin.dialogueBefore: My Spearow is super fast! You can't hit it!
youngster_calvin.dialogueAfter: Too fast for me, I guess.

lass_sally.name: Sally
lass_sally.title: Lass
lass_sally.dialogueBefore: Want to see my cute Pokémon?
lass_sally.dialogueAfter: They're still cute even though we lost!

bug_catcher_james.name: James
bug_catcher_james.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_james.dialogueBefore: Check out my well-raised Bug Pokémon!

lass_robin.name: Robin
lass_robin.title: Lass
lass_robin.dialogueBefore: My Jigglypuff's song will put you right to sleep!

bug_catcher_sammy.name: Sammy
bug_catcher_sammy.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_sammy.dialogueBefore: I'm the toughest Bug Catcher in this forest!

lass_iris.name: Iris
lass_iris.title: Lass
lass_iris.dialogueAfter: Adorable and strong would be better...

super_nerd_jovan.name: Jovan
super_nerd_jovan.title: Super Nerd
super_nerd_jovan.dialogueBefore: My Electric Pokémon will shock you!

bug_catcher_robby.name: Robby
bug_catcher_robby.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_robby.dialogueBefore: Bug Pokémon thrive in caves too!
bug_catcher_robby.dialogueAfter: Even in a cave, I lose...

team_rocket_grunt_mt_moon_2.name: Grunt
team_rocket_grunt_mt_moon_2.title: Team Rocket
team_rocket_grunt_mt_moon_2.dialogueBefore: Team Rocket is after the Moon Stone!

team_rocket_grunt_mt_moon_4.name: Grunt
team_rocket_grunt_mt_moon_4.title: Team Rocket
team_rocket_grunt_mt_moon_4.dialogueBefore: This cave belongs to Team Rocket!

lass_miriam.name: Miriam
lass_miriam.title: Lass
lass_miriam.dialogueBefore: I'm looking for a Moon Stone too!

youngster_josh.name: Josh
youngster_josh.title: Youngster
youngster_josh.dialogueBefore: I got lost in this cave!
youngster_josh.dialogueAfter: Can you show me the way out?

lass_reli.name: Reli
lass_reli.title: Lass
lass_reli.dialogueBefore: My Pokémon and I are the best pair!

camper_ethan.name: Ethan
camper_ethan.title: Camper
camper_ethan.dialogueBefore: I caught this Mankey in the forest!

bug_catcher_keigo.name: Keigo
bug_catcher_keigo.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_keigo.dialogueBefore: Have you seen my friend Elijah?

picnicker_nancy.name: Nancy
picnicker_nancy.title: Picnicker
picnicker_nancy.dialogueBefore: Pikachu is so cute, isn't it?

camper_jeff.name: Jeff
camper_jeff.title: Camper
camper_jeff.dialogueBefore: I train by camping out here!

bug_catcher_cale.name: Cale
bug_catcher_cale.title: Bug Catcher
bug_catcher_cale.dialogueBefore: This bridge is the perfect place to show off my Bug Pokémon!

youngster_timmy.name: Timmy
youngster_timmy.title: Youngster
youngster_timmy.dialogueBefore: I'm the toughest kid on this bridge!

rival_route22.name: Rival
rival_route22.title: Pokémon Trainer
rival_route22.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Yo! Heading to the Pokémon League? You need Badges to get through! Let's see if you're even worth my time!
rival_route22.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Hmph! Lucky! Train harder if you want to face me again!

camper_shane.name: Shane
camper_shane.title: Camper
camper_shane.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I'm training in the tall grass, away from the bridge crowds!
camper_shane.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Strong... maybe I should train on the bridge instead.

ss_anne_gentleman_thomas.name: Thomas
ss_anne_gentleman_thomas.title: Gentleman
ss_anne_gentleman_thomas.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] A cruise is the perfect place to show off my prized Growlithes!
ss_anne_gentleman_thomas.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Magnificent... you have quite the eye for battle.

ss_anne_gentleman_arthur.name: Arthur
ss_anne_gentleman_arthur.title: Gentleman
ss_anne_gentleman_arthur.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] My Nidoran pair are raised on the finest imported feed!
ss_anne_gentleman_arthur.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Hmph. Perhaps I should switch to domestic feed.

ss_anne_lass_1f.name: Lass
ss_anne_lass_1f.title: Lass
ss_anne_lass_1f.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Isn't the sea breeze just wonderful? My Pokémon think so too!
ss_anne_lass_1f.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] The breeze wasn't on my side today...

ss_anne_youngster_1f.name: Youngster
ss_anne_youngster_1f.title: Youngster
ss_anne_youngster_1f.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I'm gonna be the toughest sailor on this ship! Starting with you!

ss_anne_sailor_trevor.name: Trevor
ss_anne_sailor_trevor.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_trevor.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] All hands on deck! That means you too, challenger!
ss_anne_sailor_trevor.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Batten down the hatches... I've been outmaneuvered.

ss_anne_sailor_edmond.name: Edmond
ss_anne_sailor_edmond.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_edmond.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I've wrestled storm waves bigger than you! Let's battle!
ss_anne_sailor_edmond.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Shiver me timbers... what a thrashing.

ss_anne_fisherman_barny.name: Barny
ss_anne_fisherman_barny.title: Fisherman
ss_anne_fisherman_barny.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I fish Pokémon straight off the side of this ship! Care to test my catch?
ss_anne_fisherman_barny.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Threw back a winner there... you fight like a riptide.

ss_anne_sailor_phillip.name: Phillip
ss_anne_sailor_phillip.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_phillip.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] My Machop hauls cargo all day. It'll haul you off this deck too!

ss_anne_sailor_huey.name: Huey
ss_anne_sailor_huey.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_huey.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] These waters are lousy with Tentacool. Want a demonstration?
ss_anne_sailor_huey.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Lousy with strong trainers too, apparently.

ss_anne_sailor_dylan.name: Dylan
ss_anne_sailor_dylan.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_dylan.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Horsea, Horsea, Horsea! Three times the seahorse, three times the trouble!

ss_anne_sailor_duncan.name: Duncan
ss_anne_sailor_duncan.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_duncan.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I swabbed these decks with champions before breakfast. You're next!
ss_anne_sailor_duncan.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Swabbed... right off the deck myself.

ss_anne_sailor_leonard.name: Leonard
ss_anne_sailor_leonard.title: Sailor
ss_anne_sailor_leonard.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] My Shellder's shell has never been cracked. Try your luck!
ss_anne_sailor_leonard.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Cracked... on the first try, even.

ss_anne_fisherman_dale.name: Dale
ss_anne_fisherman_dale.title: Fisherman
ss_anne_fisherman_dale.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Goldeen, Tentacool, Goldeen! The sea provides, kid!
ss_anne_fisherman_dale.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] The sea provides... winners, and it ain't me.

ss_anne_gentleman_brooks.name: Brooks
ss_anne_gentleman_brooks.title: Gentleman
ss_anne_gentleman_brooks.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Behold! My Pikachu, raised on the finest voyage across the seven seas!
ss_anne_gentleman_brooks.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Zapped... by a landlubber, no less.

ss_anne_lass_dawn.name: Dawn
ss_anne_lass_dawn.title: Lass
ss_anne_lass_dawn.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] My Rattata and Pikachu are the cutest duo on this ship! Fight us!

ss_anne_gentleman_lamar.name: Lamar
ss_anne_gentleman_lamar.title: Gentleman
ss_anne_gentleman_lamar.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] A gentleman never refuses a battle. My Growlithe and Ponyta insist!

rival_ss_anne.name: Rival
rival_ss_anne.title: Pokémon Trainer
rival_ss_anne.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Yo! I heard about the party on this ship and came to crash it! Let's see how much stronger I've gotten!
rival_ss_anne.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Hmph! You just lucked out! I'm heading to the captain's cabin... don't follow me!

route9_jr_trainer_1.name: Jr. Trainer
route9_jr_trainer_1.title: Jr. Trainer
route9_jr_trainer_1.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] My Pokémon are cute, but they pack a punch!
route9_jr_trainer_1.dialogueAfter: [DRAFT] Your Pokémon are stronger than they look...

route9_hiker_1.name: Hiker
route9_hiker_1.title: Hiker
route9_hiker_1.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] The mountain air makes my Pokémon tough!

route9_jr_trainer_2.name: Jr. Trainer 2
route9_jr_trainer_2.title: Jr. Trainer
route9_jr_trainer_2.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Fire types are the best! Feel the heat!

route9_hiker_2.name: Hiker 2
route9_hiker_2.title: Hiker
route9_hiker_2.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Watch out for falling rocks! And my Pokémon!

route9_bug_catcher_2.name: Bug Catcher 2
route9_bug_catcher_2.title: Bug Catcher
route9_bug_catcher_2.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Bugs are the strongest in numbers!

route9_jr_trainer_3.name: Jr. Trainer 3
route9_jr_trainer_3.title: Jr. Trainer
route9_jr_trainer_3.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I train all kinds of Pokémon!

route10_jr_trainer_1.name: Jr. Trainer
route10_jr_trainer_1.title: Jr. Trainer
route10_jr_trainer_1.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] The Power Plant makes the air tingle!

route10_hiker_1.name: Hiker
route10_hiker_1.title: Hiker
route10_hiker_1.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Rock Tunnel ahead! My Pokémon know every stone!

route10_pokemaniac_2.name: Pokémaniac 2
route10_pokemaniac_2.title: Pokémaniac
route10_pokemaniac_2.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Something amazing sleeps inside the Power Plant!

route11_gambler_1.name: Gambler
route11_gambler_1.title: Gambler
route11_gambler_1.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] I bet my Pokémon can beat yours!

route11_youngster_2.name: Youngster 2
route11_youngster_2.title: Youngster
route11_youngster_2.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] Two Pokémon are better than one!

route11_engineer_1.name: Engineer
route11_engineer_1.title: Engineer
route11_engineer_1.dialogueBefore: [DRAFT] My Magnemite runs on pure voltage!

route11_engineer_2.name: Engineer 2
